title: Runnable Core & Utilities
summary: This module defines the foundational `Runnable` interface for composable units of work, enabling serialization, dynamic configuration, and specialized functionalities like chat history management and external component loading.

nodes.label: Define Core Runnable Interface
nodes.title: Core Runnable Interface
nodes.description: The foundational abstract base class for all executable units of work, providing methods for invocation, batching, streaming, and composition, along with schema introspection and lifecycle management.

nodes.label: Enable Runnable Serialization & Dynamic Config
nodes.title: Serializable & Configurable Runnable
nodes.description: Extends the core Runnable to support JSON serialization and dynamic configuration of fields and alternatives at runtime, enhancing flexibility and reusability.

nodes.label: Base for Binding Arguments & Config
nodes.title: Runnable Binding Base
nodes.description: A foundational class for runnables that wrap and delegate to another runnable, allowing for the binding of specific arguments or configuration without altering the wrapped runnable's core logic.

nodes.label: Base for Processing List Elements
nodes.title: Runnable for List Processing
nodes.description: A foundational class for runnables that apply a wrapped runnable to each item in an input list, efficiently handling batching and streaming for individual elements.

nodes.label: Manage Dynamic Runnable Selection
nodes.title: Dynamically Configurable Runnable
nodes.description: A serializable runnable that acts as a proxy, dynamically selecting and delegating to an underlying runnable based on runtime configuration, enabling configurable fields and alternatives.

nodes.label: Manage Conversational History
nodes.title: Conversational History Manager
nodes.description: A specialized runnable that wraps another runnable to manage chat message history, loading existing conversations, injecting them into the runnable's input, and updating history with the runnable's output.

nodes.label: Pass Input & Assign Additional Data
nodes.title: Input Passthrough & Assignment
nodes.description: A utility runnable that passes its input through unchanged, with the option to assign additional keys to the output (if input is a dictionary) or execute a side-effect function.

nodes.label: Load Components from LangChain Hub
nodes.title: LangChain Hub Component Loader
nodes.description: Enables loading and integrating runnables published on the LangChain Hub, facilitating easy sharing, discovery, and reuse of pre-built components.

nodes.label: Route Based on OpenAI Tool Calls
nodes.title: OpenAI Function Call Router
nodes.description: A specialized runnable that parses OpenAI function/tool call outputs and dispatches messages to different sub-runnables based on the identified function name, enabling dynamic routing in agents.

nodes.label: Wrap Async StopIteration
nodes.title: Async Exception Handler
nodes.description: An internal utility that wraps asynchronous function calls to convert `StopIteration` exceptions into `RuntimeError`s, preventing issues in `asyncio.Future` handling.

nodes.label: Chat Message History Interface
nodes.title: Chat History Interface
nodes.description: Defines the interface for storing and retrieving chat messages, used by runnables that manage conversational state.

nodes.label: LangChain Hub Repository
nodes.title: LangChain Hub
nodes.description: An external repository for sharing and discovering LangChain components, including runnables.

nodes.label: Parse JSON Function Calls
nodes.title: JSON Function Parser
nodes.description: An output parser that extracts structured JSON function call information from language model outputs.

nodes.label: Route to Sub-Runnables
nodes.title: Runnable Router
nodes.description: A runnable that dispatches input to one of several sub-runnables based on a routing key.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Foundational Runnable Interfaces
groups.description: These components define the fundamental building blocks and extensible interfaces for all runnable units of work in the LangChain ecosystem.

groups.label: Binding & Configuration
groups.title: Runnable Modification & Dynamic Setup
groups.description: Components in this group provide mechanisms for modifying, configuring, and dynamically adapting the behavior of other runnables at runtime.

groups.label: Specialized Runnables
groups.title: Concrete Runnable Implementations
groups.description: This group contains concrete runnable implementations designed for specific tasks, such as managing conversational history, data flow utilities, and integration with external services.

groups.label: Internal Utilities
groups.title: Module Internal Helpers
groups.description: Helper functions and utilities that support the core functionality of the runnables module, often dealing with low-level concerns like exception handling.
